extDescription.message: Blocks over 500,000 adult websites right in the browser. No telemetry: everything runs locally.

blockedLead.message: This site contains adult content. Your protection worked — and that is the right choice.

ayahTranslation.message: Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and guard their chastity. That is purer for them.

popupStatusHint.message: Always active and cannot be turned off.

popupPrivacy.message: Everything runs locally: your browsing history is never sent anywhere.

welcomeLead.message: Block Haram is already blocking adult sites and has turned on safe search. A couple of steps make it hard to get around.

stepIncognitoText.message: Without this, sites are not blocked in Incognito windows. Open the extension settings and turn on “Allow in Incognito”.

stepPinText.message: Click the puzzle icon next to the address bar and pin Block Haram to see its stats.

stepLockText.message: Any extension can be removed. On Windows, the computer administrator can lock Block Haram in with browser policies and disable Incognito and Guest mode.
